title: Design System: MATH for the TI-84 Plus CE

body.purpose: DrSans bitmap, 14 px line, 11 px ascent. Problem, answer, step maths, menu labels, typed input.

label.purpose: DrSans bitmap, 10 px line, 8 px ascent. Captions, step numbers, panel titles, footer, mode, approximations, errors; exponents and bounds inside maths.

components.name: Title Strip
components.description: Teal band at the top of every screen: title or problem on the left, mode on the right.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 320px; height: 20px; padding: 0 8px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #0B6E64; color: #FBFAF6; font: 14px/14px monospace; } .ds-strip small { font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; }

components.name: Answer Box
components.description: Tinted box with a 3 px teal left bar; exact answer in ink, approximation in teal on the right.
components.css: .ds-answer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; width: 304px; padding: 5px 8px 5px 10px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #DCEFEB; border-left: 3px solid #0B6E64; color: #1D2433; font: 14px/14px monospace; } .ds-answer small { color: #0B6E64; font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; }

components.name: Step Row
components.description: Numbered step: teal number in an 18 px margin tab, caption above in secondary, maths below in ink.
components.html:
1
Subtract 3 from both sides
2x = 4
components.css: .ds-step { display: flex; width: 320px; background: #FBFAF6; color: #1D2433; font: 14px/14px monospace; padding: 4px 0 5px; } .ds-step-tab { width: 18px; margin-right: 6px; text-align: center; color: #0B6E64; font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; } .ds-step-cap { color: #5F6676; font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; margin-bottom: 2px; }

components.name: Step Row Selected
components.description: The selected step: pale row, tab filled teal, number in paper. Teal triangle after the caption when it has sub-steps.
components.html:
2
Divide both sides by 2 ▼
x = 2
components.css: .ds-step-sel { display: flex; width: 320px; background: #EEF6F4; color: #1D2433; font: 14px/14px monospace; } .ds-step-sel-tab { width: 18px; margin-right: 6px; padding-top: 4px; text-align: center; background: #0B6E64; color: #FBFAF6; font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; } .ds-step-sel > div:last-child { padding: 4px 0 5px; } .ds-step-sel-cap { color: #5F6676; font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-step-sel-cap b { color: #0B6E64; font-weight: normal; }

components.name: Sub-step
components.description: An opened sub-step: no number, indented 10 px behind a 1 px sub-step rule, maths at body size.
components.html:
Do the same to both sides
2x/2 = 4/2
components.css: .ds-sub { margin-left: 26px; padding: 4px 0 5px 7px; border-left: 1px solid #B9D9D3; background: #FBFAF6; color: #1D2433; font: 14px/14px monospace; } .ds-sub-cap { color: #5F6676; font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; margin-bottom: 2px; }

components.name: Menu Panel
components.description: Framed paper panel with a secondary title; selected row marked with the pale row and the filled teal tab.
components.html:
What to do
Simplify
Expand
Factor
components.css: .ds-menu { width: 304px; padding: 6px 0 4px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBFAF6; border: 1px solid #D9DCD6; font: 14px/14px monospace; } .ds-menu-title { padding-left: 26px; height: 16px; color: #5F6676; font-size: 10px; line-height: 10px; } .ds-menu-row { height: 20px; line-height: 20px; padding-left: 26px; color: #1D2433; } .ds-menu-row-sel { background: linear-gradient(to right, #0B6E64 18px, #EEF6F4 18px); }

components.name: Footer
components.description: Key hints for the current screen only: key in ink, action in secondary. Teal down-triangle at the right when more steps are below.
components.css: .ds-foot { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 9px; width: 320px; height: 14px; padding: 2px 6px 0; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBFAF6; border-top: 1px solid #D9DCD6; color: #5F6676; font: 10px/10px monospace; } .ds-foot b { color: #1D2433; font-weight: normal; margin-right: 3px; } .ds-foot i { position: absolute; right: 6px; color: #0B6E64; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Error Text
components.description: Error message under the input rule, label size, error red.

narrative.overview:
Every result is set like a worked example in a maths textbook: the problem sits in a teal strip at the top, the answer sits in a tinted box under it, and the method follows as numbered steps, each with a short caption above its line of maths. Any step that has smaller rewrites inside it opens in place to show them, indented behind a thin rule.

The screen is a sheet of warm paper with dark ink and one teal. Teal carries the structure (strip, step numbers, the answer box's left bar, the cursor, approximations, disclosure marks); everything else is ink, a muted secondary grey, or a 1 px rule. Hierarchy comes from two font sizes, colour and position, never from weight, boxes-in-boxes or shadow. The look rejects both the stock TI-OS look (grey bars, a full-width blue selection bar) and the phone-app look (a stack of rounded cards).

The platform sets hard limits: 320x240 pixels, an 8-bit palette, two bitmap fonts, keypad only. Density is moderate on purpose: the answer must read at a glance, and a step should fit on one line before any fallback kicks in.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, ink text, one teal for structure.
Square corners, 1 px rules, no shadows.
One selection mark everywhere: the 18 px filled teal margin tab on a pale row.
Maths drawn in 2D: real fractions, raised exponents, drawn radicals, integrals and stretched brackets.
A footer that lists only the keys that act on the current screen.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only accent. Anything that marks structure, selection or a secondary reading of the answer is teal or one of its two tints; no second hue is added for emphasis.

rules.name: The Quiet Words Rule
rules.body: Words that frame the maths (captions, "or", footer actions, panel titles) are secondary grey; the maths itself is ink.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two sizes and one weight. A new kind of text takes one of the two sizes and is told apart by colour or position, not by a third size or bold.

rules.name: The Caption Above Rule
rules.body: A step's caption sits above its maths in the label size, secondary grey, the way a textbook writes the reason above the line.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A panel that sits over another screen is separated by its 1 px rule frame and nothing else.

dos: **Do** mark every selection, in any list, with the pale row and the 18 px filled teal tab.
**Do** set step captions above the maths, label size, secondary grey.
**Do** show approximations in teal at the label size, after the exact answer.
**Do** draw fractions, exponents, roots, integrals and limits in 2D, and stretch brackets with the content.
**Do** list in the footer only the keys that act on the current screen.
**Do** keep panels, boxes and rules on the 8 px side inset.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent colour, a third font size, or bold.
**Don't** use a full-width solid selection bar or grey title bars (the stock TI-OS look).
**Don't** stack results as separate rounded cards (the phone-app look).
**Don't** list keys in the footer that do nothing on the screen shown.
